resources.string: In the MaxCare app on the parent’s phone, choose “Add child” and enter the 8-digit code here. The code is valid for 10 minutes.
Only a parent needs it: to turn off protection or change settings on this phone. At least 6 characters. Do not show it to the child.
Android will ask you to turn on the MaxCare Kids device admin. It is needed for protection. On some phones the app can still be removed together with the device admin.
MaxCare Kids always shows a notification that protection is on, so the child knows about it. Allow notifications to continue.

MaxCare Kids sends this phone\'s location to you — periodically and in the background, even when the app is closed — so you can see where your child is. Tap “Allow location”, then choose “Allow all the time”.

MaxCare Kids sends you how long each app was on this phone’s screen each day — every 15 minutes, in the background. Only the app name and minutes are sent: not what your child watched, wrote or searched in it. Tap “Open access”, find MaxCare Kids in the list and turn on usage access.
On this phone the system may stop MaxCare Kids in the background. In the app settings, allow autostart and turn off battery restrictions for MaxCare Kids.
Full protection: the app cannot be removed, and safe mode and factory reset are blocked.
Basic protection. On some phones the app can still be removed together with the device admin.
Enter the parent password. After that, MaxCare Kids can be removed like any other app.
In the MaxCare app, open the child’s phone and get a recovery code. The code is valid for up to 10 minutes. This phone does not need internet.
MaxCare Kids no longer protects this phone. You can now remove the app in Settings.
Enter the 8 digits of the code.
The code is wrong, expired or already used. Get a new code.
Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
No internet connection. Check the connection and try again.
The connection is not secure, so it was stopped. Try another network.
The password must be at least 6 characters.
Wrong password. Attempts left before a pause: %1$d
Too many wrong attempts. Try again in %1$d min.
Protection data on this phone is damaged. Use a recovery code from the parent app.
The device admin is not on. Tap “Turn on” and confirm.
Notifications are off. Turn them on in the settings.
Wrong code. Attempts left before a pause: %1$d
This phone is not connected to a parent, so a recovery code cannot be checked.

MaxCare Kids turns on a local VPN to filter websites. It sees only the names of sites the phone opens, not the pages themselves.

• Site names are sent, encrypted, to the family DNS service Cloudflare for Families, which blocks adult and dangerous sites.
• Google, Bing, Yandex and DuckDuckGo search and YouTube are switched to safe mode.
• Betting and gambling sites are blocked.
• The parent sees the address and category of each blocked site. Addresses of other sites are not sent to MaxCare.

Android will ask for permission to set up a VPN connection.
The filter is not on. Tap “Turn on the filter” and allow the VPN connection.

The child and everything collected about this phone — events, route, app time and limits — will be deleted from the parent’s app. MaxCare Kids data on this phone will be erased and the app will close.
